name: Rift bomb
description: a round black iron bomb cracked with glowing violet-pink rift light, a short lit fuse sparking on top

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, centered in the frame with plenty of empty space around it, the whole object visible. One object alone, nothing else, no hands, no person. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is this object. Show the exact same object {action}. Keep everything about it the same as image 1: shape, colors, size and position in the frame and art style. {background}

idle.action: sits, the fuse sparking and fizzing, the violet cracks pulsing
